    Simulation checkout

    Demo economics & stock allocations

    These are explicit prototype assumptions, not validated cafe economics or demand. Selling fee 0%; incremental sale cost $0.20; fixed-order fee $0; activation cost $0.25; minimum contribution $0.25. Terminal value −$0.05/unit. Scenario weights 30%/40%/30%, including weak response, capacity limits, and outside displacement. No real checkout is connected.

    Defaults: 0/15/30/45% ladder; $0.50 minimum gain; $0 downside allowance; strict positive sales uplift; 120-minute review; 5-minute fulfillment buffer; 30-minute inventory age. One committed decision per batch/window.

    Browser-local simulation · no POS or Grubhub integration. About menu data & images
